hospital_notified: District Hospital Varanasi; SIR Sundar Lal Hospital BHU
alert_message: CRITICAL: Total Coliform 642 CFU/100mL at Varanasi (threshold 500). ML model predicts 91% probability of Cholera outbreak within 72 hours. Immediate boiling advisory and field inspection required.
resolution_notes: Water supply shut-off ordered in Sonarpura. Field team deployed. Chlorination boosted.

alert_message: WARNING: Turbidity spiked to 12.4 NTU at Patna station (WHO threshold 5 NTU). Correlated with 3 community reports. Possible upstream contamination. Enhanced monitoring activated.
resolution_notes: PHED Bihar notified. Upstream check ongoing.

hospital_notified: SSKM Medical College; Medical College Hospital Kolkata
alert_message: WARNING: pH anomaly detected at Kolkata East. pH: 9.8 (normal range 6.5-8.5). Industrial discharge suspected. Kolkata Municipal Corporation notified.
resolution_notes: PCB West Bengal engaged. Factory inspection ordered near discharge point.

alert_message: WATCH: Dissolved Oxygen dropped to 4.8 mg/L at Surat (minimum 6.0). ML model predicts continued decline over next 48 hours based on temperature and upstream data. Pre-emptive watch alert.
resolution_notes: DO slight recovery observed. Monitoring continues.

hospital_notified: District Hospital Varanasi; BHU Medical Center
alert_message: CRITICAL: ML model detected correlation between 8 community reports of waterborne illness and elevated fecal coliform 380 CFU/100mL. Cholera cluster likely. Emergency response needed.
resolution_notes: Emergency response team activated. Additional CPCB sampling ordered.

alert_message: WARNING: BOD exceeded limit at Kanpur station. BOD: 5.2 mg/L (threshold 3.0). Industrial discharge likely from leather industry effluent. UPPCB notified.
resolution_notes: UPPCB filed show cause notice to 3 tanneries. Effluent treatment plant inspection in progress.

alert_message: HIGH RISK: ML model predicts 72% probability of waterborne disease outbreak in Muzaffarpur within 5 days based on multi-parameter trend analysis + recent patient data from ABDM.
resolution_notes: Preventive boiling advisory issued. Health camps initiated in Mithanpura.

alert_message: MODERATE: TDS levels at 620 mg/L at Kolkata East Canal (max 500 mg/L). Suspected saline intrusion from recent cyclone. Water not suitable for drinking. Tanker supply requested.
resolution_notes: Tanker water supply arranged. TDS returning to normal after 48 hours.

hospital_notified: Hamidia Hospital Bhopal; Gandhi Medical College
alert_message: HIGH: 14 community reports from MP Nagar zone reporting yellowish water and GI illness. ML model correlates with drop in lake water level post-heatwave. Sent to CMO Bhopal.
resolution_notes: PHED inspection team deployed to MP Nagar. Water samples collected.

alert_message: MODERATE: Ammonia levels elevated at Delhi Wazirabad (1.8 mg/L vs threshold 0.5 mg/L). Sewage overflow from upstream suspected. Delhi Jal Board notified. Monitoring enhanced.
resolution_notes: Sewage overflow point identified. Emergency repair underway.

hospital_notified: Diamond Harbour Govt Hospital; Medical College Kolkata
alert_message: CRITICAL: ML model detected 84% probability of cholera outbreak in South 24 Parganas. Multi-parameter degradation over 7 days + ABDM patient data shows 23 cases in last 3 days. Immediate action required.
acknowledged_by: Dr. Susan Paul CMO South 24 PGS
resolution_notes: Cholera rapid response team deployed. ORS distribution started.

alert_message: WATCH: Nitrate levels at 16.8 mg/L in Guwahati station (WHO limit for children: 10 mg/L). Potential risk of methemoglobinemia. Advisory issued for households with infants.
resolution_notes: Communication sent to ASHA workers in affected area.

alert_message: RESOLVED: Dissolved Oxygen at Chennai Cooum returned to 6.4 mg/L. Water quality restored to safe levels following treatment intervention. All-clear issued.
resolution_notes: DO levels stable for 48 hours. Monitoring continues at normal frequency.

hospital_notified: Motilal Nehru Medical College; SRN Hospital Prayagraj
alert_message: HIGH: Fecal coliform spiked to 220 CFU/100mL post-religious gathering at Sangam. ML model predicts 76% pathogen outbreak risk. Pilgrims advised to use packaged water.
resolution_notes: Mass ORS distribution at Sangam ghats. NRDC deployed mobile water testing units.

alert_message: MODERATE: 6 community reports from Majitha Road area about discoloured canal water. Two patients admitted to GMC Amritsar. Field investigation initiated by Punjab Pollution Control Board.
resolution_notes: Discharge from dyeing unit identified. Notice issued. Canal now flushing.
